_comment: The core-declared file form for chimera's project wizard: categories, cardinality (max -1 = unbounded), accepted formats, tooltip help. Chimera renders and enforces; this file decides. Slot ids are what project manifests record.

slots.title: Cartridge
slots.help: The NES cartridge image in iNES format (.nes).

slots.title: Save data
slots.help: What a battery-backed cartridge starts with already saved. This is the file Emulator > Export Save Data... writes - battery.sav, the cart's 8KB of WRAM - put back so a run can continue from where another left off. It is mounted read-only and pinned by hash, and the movie cites it, so a movie that starts from a saved game is as reproducible as one that starts from a fresh cart. A cartridge with no battery keeps no saves, and the project will say so rather than load one. Leave it empty and the cart starts as it came.
